# Chaos

> > Chaos develops industry-leading 3D rendering and visualization software including V-Ray, Corona, Phoenix FD, and Enscape for film, VFX, architectural visualization, and design.

Chaos (formerly Chaos Group) provides production rendering solutions used by major studios like Digital Domain, Imageworks, and Method Studios. The company offers rendering software for Maya, 3ds Max, Rhino, SketchUp, and Unreal Engine, alongside educational content through the CG Garage podcast hosted by Christopher Nichols.

## Key Topics

- V-Ray
- Corona
- Enscape
- Phoenix FD
- 3D rendering
- GPU rendering
- Real-time rendering
- Photorealistic rendering
- Architectural visualization (ArchViz)
- VFX and visual effects
- Ray tracing
- Maya and 3ds Max integration
- Production rendering
- CG Garage podcast

- [Chaos Enscape pricing & plans — buy online](https://www.chaos.com/enscape/buy-online): Enscape pricing and subscription plans for real-time rendering software
